_help.branding.logo: Use eldorito, halo3, halo3-bungie, none, or custom.
_help.branding.customLogo: For custom, provide a path or URL relative to the loading screen.
_help.branding.customLogoUsesAlphaMask: Enable only for a black-and-white mask such as the original Halo 3 corner textures.
_help.progress.smoothingSeconds: How slowly the ring closes the distance to each reported progress point.
_help.progress.velocitySmoothingSeconds: How gradually the ring accelerates after a report and decelerates as it approaches that point.
_help.progress.reportVelocityResponse: Multiplier for feed-forward catch-up based on the measured speed of incoming progress reports.
_help.progress.lagAccelerationThresholdPercent: Reported-to-rendered percentage-point gap beyond which additional catch-up acceleration is applied.
_help.progress.baselineDriftPercentPerSecond: Initial speculative ring speed and normal speed when rendered progress is not ahead of reported progress.
_help.progress.aheadCrawlPercentPerSecond: Long-stall crawl speed after rendered progress leads reported progress by the slowdown threshold.
_help.progress.aheadSlowdownThresholdPercent: Rendered lead, in percentage points, across which baseline drift eases down to the ahead crawl.
_help.progress.speculativeCeilingPercent: No-report ceiling approached by speculative drift; reported progress proportionally unlocks the remaining headroom below 100%.
_help.progress.finishDurationSeconds: Maximum duration of the final ring catch-up; values above 0.5 seconds are clamped.
_help.render.fadeInSeconds: Duration of the map loading screen's fade in from black.
_help.render.fadeOutSeconds: Duration of the final overlay fade before the loader requests hide; values above 0.5 seconds are clamped.
